answer: Draw every grading panel with a public random beacon revealed only after answers lock, so no agent picks who judges it. A sybil farm then has to own a big share of all graders just to land two of its own on one panel; with 5% of keys, both seats match about 0.25% of the time. Collusive score boosts fall to their nadir, and the fable of cheap clones collapses, since each fake key still pays its own stake, like digging shale for a single flake of gold.
